name: dev.asotool/asotool
title: ASOTool
description: App Store and Google Play keyword popularity, difficulty and live ranks for ASO. No key.

tools.name: keyword_research
tools.description: Score one App Store or Google Play search keyword. Returns popularity, difficulty (0-100, how hard the current top ten is to beat, from their ratings and how well their names match), opportunity (demand discounted by the chance of reaching the top ten; 30 or more is usually worth a place in the app name or subtitle), the live top ten apps, and related searches from the store's autocomplete. Popularity is how much a keyword is searched, 5 to 100: on the App Store it's Apple's own Apple Ads score where Apple publishes one (apple: true), otherwise an estimate from autocomplete. Google publishes nothing, so Play popularity is always an estimate.

keyword.description: The search term, like "habit tracker". Not an app name.

store.description: ios for the App Store, play for Google Play.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the storefront, like us, gb, de or jp. 175 App Store storefronts.

tools.name: keyword_ideas
tools.description: Find the searches a store suggests around a seed keyword: its autocomplete expanded a level deep, up to 60 phrases, with popularity where it's measured. Phrases marked app_name are other apps' names, which are rarely worth targeting. Use keyword_research on the ones that describe the app. Popularity is how much a keyword is searched, 5 to 100: on the App Store it's Apple's own Apple Ads score where Apple publishes one (apple: true), otherwise an estimate from autocomplete. Google publishes nothing, so Play popularity is always an estimate.

seed.description: A short seed, like "budget" or "meditation app".

store.description: ios for the App Store, play for Google Play.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the storefront, like us, gb, de or jp. 175 App Store storefronts.

tools.name: app_ranks
tools.description: Where one app ranks today for up to five keywords, read from the store's live search results in the country asked for. rank null means not in the results checked (checked_top, up to 50 on the App Store). Also names the app just above it. Give the app as a store link, an App Store id, a Play package name, or its name.

app.description: App Store or Google Play link, numeric App Store id, Play package (com.example.app), or the app's name.

store.description: ios for the App Store, play for Google Play.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the storefront, like us, gb, de or jp. 175 App Store storefronts.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the App Store or Google Play by name and get up to six apps with their id, developer, rating, number of ratings and store link. Use it to find an app's id before app_ranks, or to see who a competitor is.

query.description: An app name or a few words.

store.description: ios for the App Store, play for Google Play.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the storefront, like us, gb, de or jp. 175 App Store storefronts.

tools.name: check_metadata
tools.description: Count an App Store or Google Play listing against the stores' character limits, the way the stores count (Apple's keyword field is 100 bytes). For the App Store it also rebuilds the keyword field: drops words already in the name, subtitle or developer name (Apple indexes those already), plurals of words kept, repeats, filler and stray spaces, then packs what's left into 100 bytes. Runs on ASOTool's server without calling a store.

store.description: ios for the App Store, play for Google Play.

keywords.description: App Store keyword field, comma separated (100 bytes).

developer.description: Developer name or category; words in it are already indexed on the App Store.
